symptom: `$Guid = call java action CommunityCommons.getGUID();` — getGUID's `item: TypeParameter not null` left out — passed check and exec; mx check reported CE0115.
file: mdl/executor/validate.go missingCodeActionArgs (now takes requiredParams), the stored-action and in-script call paths, mustPassParams
cause: #2464 reported a missing argument only for an entity-type parameter, because its 11.12.6 measurement had found Integer, object and type-parameter omissions build clean — but every parameter in that matrix was nullable. A `not null` (IsRequired) parameter left out is CE0115.
fix: A call to a Java action is refused when it leaves out an entity-type parameter or a required one, for a stored action (JavaActionParameter.IsRequired) and one the script creates (ast IsRequired). JavaScript actions keep the entity-type rule only: their required case is unmeasured.
insight: A measurement matrix that holds one variable fixed answers nothing about it: #2464 varied the parameter TYPE and left every parameter nullable, so 'Integer omitted builds clean' was true only for nullable Integer. Before concluding 'kind X is fine', vary the flags too (required/nullable). Measured on 11.14.0: getGUID, Integer not null and T not null omitted -> CE0115 each; the nullable Integer and T -> clean.
test: mdl/executor/code_action_missing_args_2464_test.go TestMissingCodeActionArgs_Required2577 (required reported, nullable not, passed not); live: CommunityCommons 11.5.1 installed on TestApp, check refuses getGUID() and a same-script `not null` action, passes the nullable one
